visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor office setting, a group of about seven people are gathered. An older man in a black suit and glasses stands center, gesturing with his hands. To his left, a younger man in a grey suit and red tie holds a microphone. The background features red frames with photos and a banner with musical notes. (2) The scene cuts to the group clapping enthusiastically. A woman on the left wears colorful oversized glasses and a pink scarf. (3) The camera focuses on the young man in the grey suit as he speaks into the microphone, his expression becoming more serious. The background shifts to a wall covered in framed portraits of various people. (4) A man in a dark suit sits in a modern chair against a plain wall with a small plant, looking directly at the camera with a neutral, steady gaze. (5) Back in the office, the young man in the grey suit points towards the floor. A woman in a pink polo shirt and black waist bag, holding a cleaning basket and a mop, appears startled. She stares blankly at the camera while holding her cleaning tools. (6) The young man hands a red envelope to the woman in pink. The group around them begins to clap. (7) A montage shows the woman in the pink shirt performing various cleaning tasks: wiping a glass window, cleaning a computer monitor, and vacuuming a purple rug. (8) Finally, the woman in pink stands amongst the group again, holding the red envelope and an award certificate. Everyone is smiling and clapping for her.
